HubSpot AI-native CRM startup threat displace 2026

findings.claim: HubSpot 10-K FY2025 的競爭對手清單新增「AI agent 提供者」與「AI-native CRM 及工作流自動化新創」，並提到通用 LLM、vibe coding 等非專業方案可能搶單。
findings.excerpt: •data enrichment vendors; •AI agent and providers; •AI-native CRM and workflow automation startups; and •large-scale enterprise suites.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司可能面對依賴通用 LLM、生成式 AI 與通用 agent 的非專業方案競爭，需說服客戶其產品優於 vibe coding 等替代；對手可能以綑綁近零成本提供平台，迫使降價。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We may also face greater competition from non-specialist solutions relying on generic large language models (“LLMs”), generative AI and general-purpose agents to address a broad range of business needs.

findings.claim: SaaStr 2026 摘要稱多數現今 YC 新創已不使用 Salesforce 或 HubSpot（新進入者／AI-native CRM 趨勢）。
findings.source: NextGenABM: key takeaways from SaaStr AI 2026
findings.excerpt: Salesforce and HubSpot are doing what incumbents do: layering agents across what they already have. Salesforce is buying its way there: Agentforce, plus recent acquisitions like Qualified (inbound agent) and Momentum (auto-transcribes every call into the CRM).

note: 搜尋僅得二手聚合與競爭廠商行銷文，無一手份額數據；二手稱 HubSpot 約 5-6% CRM 份額且成長快於 Salesforce，但各來源數字互相矛盾，未採為 finding。未見 HubSpot 流失份額的直接證據。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
